lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank. These blobs are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the branchial slits, with vertical alignment predominating over horizontal consistency.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a discernible lattice structure where the blobs serve as anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is observed along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the central and basal regions of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a dense, vermiculated patterning consisting of small, interconnected high-luminance spots and irregular lines, which differs significantly from the more ordered grid pattern of the posterior flank.
